en.title: Peru Accessibility Law Creates New Barriers Despite Good Intentions
en.summary: A new accessibility law in Peru has unintentionally created obstacles, highlighting implementation challenges. Meanwhile, a two‑year‑old DOJ settlement led to accessibility upgrades at Durham’s West Point park, and tech firms Google and Microsoft announced accessibility‑focused updates. Finally, a Shakespeare production incorporated captioning and sensory‑friendly performances to welcome disabled audiences.

zh-TW.title: 秘魯無障礙法反生新障礙，凸顯實施挑戰
zh-TW.summary: 秘魯一部新無障礙法雖善意卻意外製造新障礙，凸顯法律實施的困難。同時，美國達勒姆西點恩諾公園在司法部和解二十年後完成無障礙改善，而莎士比亞劇《如你所願》加入字幕與感官友善演出，提升殘障觀眾體驗。最後，LG 永續報告顯示其提前達標減碳目標並強化無障礙體驗，日本網友則討論學歷制度對身心障礙者的就業障礙。
